授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: 環境農学に関する土環境・水環境・山地森林と渓流環境などに関する概要的知識を身につける。土と水に関する様々な問題点を理解し，その対策を立案できる。
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）:
The objective is to expertise the knowledge on soi, water, mountain forest and mountain stream environments; what have been happened and how shall we manage them properly taking into consideration of sustainability.
Various kinds of issues on soil and water are introduced and the students are requested to understand them properly and consider the proper measures for sustainability.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード: geosciences, geology, topography, hydorology, landuse, irrigation, soil, forest, landslides, torrents
